description: PB-52 RTO operates as the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) office in Bassi Pathana, serving as a secondary registration authority for the Fatehgarh Sahib district. It handles vehicle registration, licensing, and transport permits specifically for the Bassi Pathana sub-division. This office ensures decentralized transport services for residents who would otherwise have to travel to the main district headquarters.
address: SDM Office, Bassi Pathana, District Fatehgarh Sahib, Punjab
